caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object with a predominantly brown background and a textured, mosaic-like appearance. At the center, there is a cluster of flowers composed of various colors: white, red, purple, blue, and green. The flowers have white and red petals, purple and blue blossoms, and green stems and leaves. Surrounding the central floral arrangement, a yellow, curving, vine-like border forms an inner frame with ornate corners. Each corner of the border features decorative elements that incorporate shades of purple, blue, and yellow. The brown background is lighter toward the center and becomes darker toward the edges. The drawing is signed “RUTH N. BARNES” in the lower right corner and has some additional notations in black ink in the lower left corner. The image is presented on a plain, off-white paper background.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
